_editingNotes.howToEdit: Delete any copy you don't like, edit wording, or add new options. More options = less repetition.

variables.{forecastSnowTotal}: Total forecasted snow in next few days

tips: Headlines: Keep short and punchy (2-6 words ideal)
Body: Can be longer, more descriptive (1-2 sentences)
The system never repeats the same copy two days in a row
Weekend headline variants used ~40% on Sat/Sun
